svg.aria-label: MindNest — An AI companion for people living with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI). Familiar-face recognition (OpenCV YuNet + SFace); Conversation memory using embeddings + RAG; Reminders, geofencing and caregiver alerts. Built with Django REST, React Native, OpenCV, Gemini.
